data_gaps.reason: The supplied pages state put price as face value plus accrued interest and refer to the redemption clause for accrued interest calculation, but do not state a separate accrued-interest rule.
The supplied pages state one exercise per interest year after first satisfaction, but do not state a numeric annual exercise limit.
The supplied pages state a continuous 30 trading day observation window for the put trigger, but do not state a separate observation window value.
The supplied pages state at least 15 trading days below 70% of the conversion price, but do not state a separate required days value.
The supplied pages state the put trigger as 70% of the current conversion price, but do not state a separate trigger ratio value.
The supplied pages state that shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain from voting, but do not state a separate bondholder abstention requirement.
The supplied pages do not state whether a net asset floor clause is present or absent.
The supplied pages do not state whether a par value floor clause is present or absent.
The supplied pages do not state the contract position on below-net-asset issuances.
The supplied pages do not state the issue date; page 27 mentions a record date 2020-12-22 (T-1) and page 28 mentions subscription dates 2020-12-23 (T), but no explicit issue date is given.
The supplied pages state a six-year term from the issue date but do not provide the issue date or an explicit maturity date.
The supplied pages state a face value of RMB 100 per bond and issuance at par, but do not state a separate denomination amount.
The supplied pages describe interest payment date deferral for holidays, but do not state a general holiday deferral rule for all payments.
The supplied pages provide the accrued interest formula for redemption, but do not state a separate accrued-interest redemption rule.
The supplied pages state the maturity redemption price of 112% of face value including final interest, but do not state a separate maturity redemption price rule.
The supplied pages state redemption within five trading days after maturity, but do not state a numeric window in days.
The supplied pages state put price as face value plus accrued interest and refer to the redemption clause for accrued interest calculation, but do not state a separate accrued-interest rule.
The supplied pages state one exercise per interest year after first satisfaction, but do not state a numeric annual exercise limit.
The supplied pages state a continuous 30 trading day observation window for the put trigger, but do not state a separate observation window value.
The supplied pages state at least 15 trading days below 70% of the conversion price, but do not state a separate required days value.
The supplied pages state the put trigger as 70% of the current conversion price, but do not state a separate trigger ratio value.
The supplied pages describe treatment of adjustment days for the down-revision trigger, but do not state a separate adjustment day treatment value.
The supplied pages state that shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain from voting, but do not state a separate bondholder abstention requirement.
The supplied pages do not state whether a net asset floor clause is present or absent.
The supplied pages do not state whether a par value floor clause is present or absent.
The supplied pages do not state the contract position on below-net-asset issuances.
The supplied pages state the conversion period starts six months after issuance ends, but do not provide the issue date or an explicit start date.
The supplied pages state the conversion period ends on the maturity date, but do not provide an explicit maturity date.

在本次发行的可转债存续期间，当公司股票在任意连续 30 个交易日中至少
15 个交易日的收盘价低于当期转股价格的 90%时，公司董事会有权提出转股价
格向下修正方案并提交公司股东大会表决。

在本次发行的可转债存续期间，当公司股票在任意连续 30 个交易日中至少
15 个交易日的收盘价低于当期转股价格的 90%时，公司董事会有权提出转股价
格向下修正方案并提交公司股东大会表决。

上述方案须经出席会议的股东所持表决权的三分之二以上通过方可实施。股
东大会进行表决时，持有本次发行的可转债的股东应当回避。修正后的转股价格
应不低于本次股东大会召开日前 20 个交易日公司股票交易均价和前 1 个交易日
均价之间的较高者。
